title: Representational Similarity Alignment of Figurative Language in Humans and Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.09041v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often produce judgments similar to those of humans, but their interpretation of figurative language remains unclear. We compared human participants and four instruction-tuned LLMs (GPT-4, Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3.2, and Mistral-7B) on their ratings of 240 dialogue-based sentences spanning six linguistic traits: conventionality, sarcasm, funny, emotion, idiomacy, and Gen Z slang. While humans and LLMs were strongly aligned at the surface level, differences emerged in representational similarity patterns, particularly in idiomacy and Gen Z slang. GPT-4 showed the closest alignment to humans, though all models differed at the representational level, suggesting that similar outputs may arise from different underlying language representations. We also examined the relationship between model scale and representational similarity using the Gemma model series (Gemma-2-9B-IT, Gemma-3-27B-IT, and Gemma-4-31B-IT),

translated_title: 人类与大型语言模型在比喻语言上的表征相似性对齐
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）常常产生与人类相似的判断，但它们对比喻语言的理解仍不明确。我们比较了人类参与者和四个指令微调的大型语言模型（GPT-4、Gemma-2-9B、Llama-3.2和Mistral-7B）对240个基于对话的句子的评分，这些句子涵盖六种语言特征：惯例性、讽刺、有趣程度、情感、习语性和Z世代俚语。虽然人类和大型语言模型在表面层面上高度一致，但在表征相似性模式上出现了差异，尤其是在习语性和Z世代俚语方面。GPT-4表现出与人类最接近的对齐，尽管所有模型在表征层面都存在差异，这表明相似的输出可能源自不同的底层语言表征。我们还使用Gemma模型系列（Gemma-2-9B-IT、Gemma-3-27B-IT和Gemma-4-31B-IT）检验了模型规模与表征相似性之间的关系。
tldr: 该研究通过对比人类与四个大型语言模型对240个涵盖六种语言特征的对话句子的评分发现，虽然两者在表面层面高度一致，但在表征相似性层面存在显著差异，表明相似的输出可能源于不同的底层语言表征。
en_tdlr: Although large language models align strongly with humans at the surface level in rating figurative language, representational similarity analysis reveals differences in underlying language representations, suggesting that similar outputs may arise from different internal representations.
